x: Bernard Linley, a great prospect, won the 440 in a canter from Mike Smithers, whilst our Junior Capt. Brian Kolbe was third in the 880 with 2:7.0 and Eric Penny 4th in the mile with 4:46.4.

Bernard Linley, who will soon be knocking at the door of our senior teams, finished second in his first half-mile with 2:2.1, and soon after, over his favourite distance of 440 yards ran out a creditable winner in 54 .5 secs.
Bernard Linley was runner-up in both the Junior 100 and 880 yds with 10.8 secs and 2:09.2 respectively, and also had a fine 440 yds win in 51.9 secs. - an outstanding time for this track.

Carter streets ahead of the apposition in a 10.2 hundred, and B.Linley yet another win in the quarter with 52.0 secs. Jim McGrath did his usual quota of events, missing out the long-jump this time, with second place in the discus, third in the high-jump and fifth in the shot.
Undoubtedly the best performance of the day was that of the victorious 4 x 440 yds team of Bernard Linley (still a junior!), Charlie Jones, Peter Eldridge and London Champion Gerry LeRoy.
